bullets.text: Shrank entity-resolution review load 85% (625 to 91) on 16,243 held-out SEC Form D filings: guarded name links by issuer type, incorporation date, and fund status.

Deployed 6 collectors on a 4x/day GitHub Actions cron at $0/month: job-board APIs, SEC EDGAR, and news into Neon Postgres; sha256 event IDs make reruns insert 0 rows, and CI replays every collector twice.
13.0% of 1,000 randomly sampled active YC companies have a job board on one of the four public ATS APIs tell reads, and 30.2% (794 of 2,625) of their open postings had been open more than 90 days.
